scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter portal typecheck && pnpm --filter @webtools/mavlink typecheck && pnpm --filter @webtools/transfers typecheck
scripts.lint: pnpm --filter portal lint && pnpm --filter @webtools/mavlink lint && pnpm --filter @webtools/transfers lint
scripts.test: node --test tests/*.test.cjs && pnpm --filter @webtools/mavlink test && pnpm --filter @webtools/transfers test
scripts.build: pnpm --filter @webtools/transfers build && pnpm --filter @webtools/mavlink build && pnpm --filter portal build
